features: 【Wireless Connectivity】The 2.4GHz USB Nano Receiver Dongles Provide Reliable And Stable Connection Upto 10 Metres Range For Seamless Use Without The Clutter Of Cables.
【Chiclet Keys】Flat, Low Profile Keys For Smooth Typing Experience. Designed For Reducing Strain During Long Typing Sessions, The Spaced Out Keys Are Easy To Wipe And Clean.
【Durable Construction】The Key Life Of Keyboard Is Rated For Upto 10 Million Key Strokes, The Mouse Clicks Are Also Rated For Upto 10 Million Clicks Making Them Last Really Long.
【Power Saving Mode】Activates When The Keyboard Or Mouse Is Idle, Saving Battery Life. Instantly Wakes Up With Key Press Or Mouse Movement, Helping Reduce Battery Waste.
【Smart Auto Connect】Automatically Establishes A Stable Connection Between The Keyboard, Mouse, And Your Device Without The Need For Manual Pairing.
【Full Layout】Full Sized Keyboard Layout, 104 Total Keys For Efficient Typing & Productivity. 10 Extra Multimedia Keys For One Touch Media Controls & More. Powered By 1x AA Battery.
【6 Button Mouse】1600 DPI Adjustable Mouse With 2 Left Side Button & Dedicated DPI Button. Mouse Is Ergonomic, Buttons Are Responsive & Durable, Powered By 1x AAA Battery.
【Broad Compatibility】Recommended Use With Desktop, Laptop & PC. Plug & Play, No Drivers Needed, Works Across Multiple Platforms, Including Windows, macOS, And Linux.
